Name: Pillow Princess Farm
Author: heathinwillows
Description:
found this farm mod that i made randomly back then before my laptop broke in my telegram saves, so i figured i'd finally post it even tho I think it's still unfinished for my liking :D

sadly i still haven't got a new laptop so i won't be able to add recolor compatibility for my past 2 mods :((((

there's 2 starter gift options for this farm so make sure you choose one on the config first before starting a new save

Farmer Starter Gift:
Strawberry Seeds - 5
Parsnip Seeds - 10
Scarecrow - 1
Seed Maker - 1
Preserves Jar - 1
Dehydrator - 1
Straw hat - 1
Small Glow Ring - 1

Fisher Starter Gift:
Strawberry Seeds - 5
Parsnip Seeds - 10
Scarecrow - 1
Seed Maker - 1
Bait Maker - 1
Fish Smoker - 1
Straw hat - 1
Small Glow Ring - 1

also- if you have the Sh's Wild Animals mod or the lite version mr. beer the duckling from quiet quitting farm together with his siblings and cousins will appear on the pond in front of your farmhouse and on the fishing spot:3

Downloads.Description: - fixed the second area being buildable on a different save
